subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A school held a mental health day with workshops on stress, sleep, friendship, and asking for help.”?
options: At first, some students thought it was strange.
Some students joked about it at first.
At first, students forgot about it.
Many students were unhappy at first.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「At first, some students thought it was strange.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Some students joked about it at first.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「At first, students forgot about it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Many students were unhappy at first.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Some students joked about it at first.」，答案為「Some students joked about it at first.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Some students joked about it at first.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
